newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil steady as refiners buy.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil steady as refiners buy.

text.p: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil was steady on Friday despite sagging futures numbers amid good refiner interest for barrels, traders said.
While crude refining margins remain poor, demand for straight-run barrels is expected to remain healthy. But supply is good, too.
An ARA trader was heard to have bought an M-100 cargo, loading in Tallinn between February 10-12, at $98 cif ARA.
An NWE refiner was also heard to have bought another M-100 cargo but the price was not known.
